###F8P1 - EdU +/- BIO on lakritz mutants and their wt siblings
```{r}
BIO_EdU <- read.csv("/Users/cervenyk/Documents/fish data/Tectum_Hannah_Mate_collaboration/firstpass_figures for tectum paper/Figures 6_7_Wnt tectum figure images/Bio treatments_EdU_summer2022_jiahe.csv")

View(BIO_EdU)

#need to summarise data (n per condition; mean per condition; standard error)
group_by(BIO_EdU, Genotype, Treatment) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(count= n(),
    mean = mean(Total_Spots, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(Total_Spots, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(Total_Spots, na.rm = TRUE))

#want to order variables by treatment and genotype:
BIO_EdU$Genotype <-factor(BIO_EdU$Genotype, levels=c("WT", "lak"))
BIO_EdU$Treatment <-factor(BIO_EdU$Treatment, levels=c("DMSO", "BIO"))

#organize data so that Treatment and Genotype can be united into a variable called "Condition". Important for plotting
BIO_EdU_org <-BIO_EdU%>%
  group_by(Genotype) %>%
  group_by(Treatment) %>%
  unite("Condition", Treatment:Genotype, remove=FALSE)
```

###Generalized linear model - negative binomial. This is like we used for other datasets with counts; no need for dispersion since we don't have age related changes. 
```{r}
BIO_EdU$Genotype <-factor(BIO_EdU$Genotype, levels=c("WT", "lak"))
BIO_EdU$Treatment <-factor(BIO_EdU$Treatment, levels=c("DMSO", "BIO"))

BIO_EdU_model <- glm.nb(Total_Spots ~ Genotype * Treatment, data = BIO_EdU)
Anova(BIO_EdU_model, type = 2, test = "LR")       # terms

emm_all <- emmeans(BIO_EdU_model, ~ Genotype * Treatment, type = "response")
tab <- pairs(emm_all, adjust = "tukey", type = "response")     # all 6 pairwise comparisons, corrected together
tab.ci <- confint(pairs(emm_all, adjust = "tukey", type = "response"))

tab
tab.ci

```
###F8P1 Plot with stats signif brackets
```{r}
res <- as.data.frame(pairs(emm_all, adjust = "tukey"))
res$stars <- symnum(res$p.value, corr = FALSE, cutpoints = c(0, .001, .01, .05, 1),
                     symbols = c("***", "**", "*", "ns"))
res[, c("contrast", "p.value", "stars")]
```

```{r}
BIO_EdU_org$Condition <-factor(BIO_EdU_org$Condition, levels= c("DMSO_WT", "BIO_WT", "DMSO_lak", "BIO_lak"))

plota2 <- ggplot(BIO_EdU_org) +
  aes(x = Condition, y = Total_Spots) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(color = "black", fill = "gray", pch=21, size = 2, alpha=0.8, width=0.3) +
  theme_bw()+
  xlab("Treatment_Genotype")+
  ylab("Total EdU+ Cells")+
   theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"))+
  theme(axis.title=element_text(size = 16))+
  theme(text = element_text(size = 16))+
  geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("DMSO_WT", "BIO_WT")), annotations = "ns", y_position = 275, tip_length = 0.02, vjust = 0.05)+
  geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("DMSO_lak", "BIO_lak")), annotations = "***", y_position = 220, tip_length = 0.02, vjust = 0.5)+
  geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("DMSO_WT", "DMSO_lak")), annotations = "***", y_position = 300, tip_length = 0.02, vjust = 0.5)+
  geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("DMSO_WT", "BIO_lak")), annotations = "ns", y_position = 325, tip_length = 0.02, vjust = 0.05)+
  geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("BIO_WT", "DMSO_lak")), annotations = "***", y_position = 240, tip_length = 0.02, vjust = 0.5)+
  geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("BIO_WT", "BIO_lak")), annotations = "ns", y_position = 260, tip_length = 0.02, vjust = 0.05)

plota2
```
```{r}
ggsave ("plotBIOEdU_nofacet.png", plota2, scale = 1, width = 18, height = 10, units = "cm", dpi = 300, limitsize = TRUE, bg=NULL)
```

###F8P2 - EdU +/- BIO on one-eyed and intact larvae
```{r}
BIO_1eye <- read.csv("/Users/cervenyk/Documents/fish data/Tectum_Hannah_Mate_collaboration/firstpass_figures for tectum paper/Figures 6_7_Wnt tectum figure images/BIO_EdU_one_eyed_experiment.csv")

View(BIO_1eye)

#need to summarise data (n per condition; mean per condition; standard error)
group_by(BIO_1eye, Strain, Treatment) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(count= n(),
    mean = mean(Ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(Ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(Ratio, na.rm = TRUE))

#want to order variables by treatment and innerv_status aka Strain:
BIO_1eye$Strain <-factor(BIO_1eye$Strain, levels=c("intact", "one_eyed"))
BIO_1eye$Treatment <-factor(BIO_1eye$Treatment, levels=c("DMSO", "BIO"))

#make a single variable =  condition that combines Innerv status (Strain) and Treatment
BIO_1eye_org <-BIO_1eye%>%
  group_by(Strain) %>%
  group_by(Treatment) %>%
  unite("Condition", Treatment:Strain, remove=FALSE)
```

###F8P2 stat model = GLM - gaussian because of ratio that spans between -1 - +1
```{r}
#filter data and run model
BIO_1eye$Strain <-factor(BIO_1eye$Strain, levels=c("intact", "one_eyed"))
BIO_1eye$Treatment <-factor(BIO_1eye$Treatment, levels=c("DMSO", "BIO"))

model_1eye <- gam(Ratio ~ Strain * Treatment, 
                  family = gaussian(link = "identity"), data = BIO_1eye)
#model overall output
summary(model_1eye)
anova(gam(Ratio ~ 1, data = BIO_1eye), model_1eye, test = "F")   # overall test statistic

#Pairwise post-hoc tests with Bonferroni-Holm adjustment
posthoc_all_1eye <- emmeans(model_1eye, ~ Strain * Treatment, type = "response")
tab_1eye <- pairs(posthoc_all_1eye, adjust = "tukey", type = "response")     # all 6 pairwise comparisons, corrected together
tab_1eye.ci <- confint(pairs(posthoc_all_1eye, adjust = "tukey", type = "response"))
tab_1eye
tab_1eye.ci
```
###F8P2 Plot with stats signif brackets
```{r}
res1 <- as.data.frame(pairs(posthoc_all_1eye, adjust = "tukey"))
res1$stars <- symnum(res1$p.value, corr = FALSE, cutpoints = c(0, .001, .01, .05, 1),
                     symbols = c("***", "**", "*", "ns"))
res1[, c("contrast", "p.value", "stars")]
```
##F8P2 make plot!
```{r, echo=FALSE}
#reorder conditions on xaxis
BIO_1eye_org$Condition <- factor(BIO_1eye_org$Condition, levels = c("DMSO_intact", "BIO_intact", "DMSO_one_eyed", "BIO_one_eyed"))

plotb2 <- ggplot(BIO_1eye_org)+
  aes(x=Condition, y=Ratio)+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(color = "black", fill = "gray", pch=21, size = 2, alpha=0.8, width=0.3) +
  theme_bw()+
  xlab("Treatment and Innervation Status")+
  ylab("Ratio of EdU+ Cells")+
   theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"))+
  theme(axis.title=element_text(size = 16))+
  theme(text = element_text(size = 16))+
  
  geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("DMSO_intact", "BIO_intact")), annotations = "ns", y_position = 0.25, tip_length = 0.02, vjust = 0.05)+
  geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("DMSO_intact", "DMSO_one_eyed")), annotations = "***", y_position = 0.36, tip_length = 0.02, vjust = 0.5)+
  geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("DMSO_one_eyed", "BIO_one_eyed")), annotations = "*", y_position = 0.28, tip_length = 0.02, vjust = 0.5)+
  geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("BIO_intact", "BIO_one_eyed")), annotations = "**", y_position = 0.32, tip_length = 0.02, vjust = 0.5)+
  geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("DMSO_intact", "BIO_one_eyed")), annotations = "**", y_position = 0.40, tip_length = 0.02, vjust = 0.5)

plotb2
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
ggsave ("plotBIOEdU_one_eyed.png", plotb2, scale = 1, width = 18, height = 10, units = "cm", dpi = 300, limitsize = TRUE, bg=NULL)
```
